body.claim: This constant, not the size of the repository, is what bounds the cost of gaps.
body.detail: Stage two launches one git log -L process per undocumented declaration in the files it opens, so the cost is files times declarations, independent of corpus size. A sound tightening exists and is not implemented: a range cannot be corrected more often than the file containing it, so once enough results are held whose correction counts beat the next file rank, the remaining files need not be opened at all.
